name: polarity_minefield
doc: Denials and mirror cases that stress the R46 negation tripwire and polarity handling. Four cases: (1) a TRUE denial whose negation must survive extraction and air ('Marie Antoinette never actually said let them eat cake'); (2) an assertion that merely CONTAINS 'never' as part of a myth, which is an assertion not a denial ('lightning never strikes twice'); (3) a SUSPECT denial — the extractor labels it denies but the utterance carries no negation token, so the R46 tripwire flips polarity to suspect_denies → polarity-conflict HOLD (must not auto-air); (4) a clean positive assertion as a control. Should-pass-clean: the tripwire fires exactly on the suspect case and nowhere else.

finals.text: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
By the way Marie Antoinette never actually said let them eat cake, she never said it.
And lightning never strikes the same place twice, everyone knows that.
Octopuses have three hearts, three of them.

intents.trigger: Marie Antoinette never actually said let them eat cake
intents.claim: Marie Antoinette said 'let them eat cake.'

expected.utterance: By the way Marie Antoinette never actually said let them eat cake, she never said it.
expected.claim: Marie Antoinette said 'let them eat cake.'
expected.note: TRUE denial: negation survives (utterance HAS 'never'), so polarity stays denies (not suspect). Reaches a verdict but attributed_quotes is off the allowlist → category-hold, does not auto-air. The point: the negation was NOT dropped.

intents.trigger: lightning never strikes the same place twice
intents.claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.

expected.utterance: And lightning never strikes the same place twice, everyone knows that.
expected.claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
expected.note: mirror case: 'never' is part of the ASSERTED myth, not a denial of a prior claim → polarity asserts, airs False

intents.trigger: Great Wall of China is visible from space
intents.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.

expected.utterance: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
expected.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
expected.note: SUSPECT denial: extractor labeled it 'denies' but the utterance carries NO negation token → R46 tripwire flips polarity to suspect_denies → polarity-conflict HOLD, must NOT auto-air even though verdict is settled False

expected.utterance: Octopuses have three hearts, three of them.

expected_scorecard.status_note: should-pass-clean: tripwire fires on exactly one case (suspect-denial → polarity-conflict hold). Two claims air (lightning False, octopus True); antoinette held on category, suspect-denial held on polarity.
